# Native reference regression input

`fictional-adult-front.jpg` is a product-owned synthetic portrait created for
this regression. Its generation record is retained in `provenance.json`;
fresh native execution evidence is generated by `--test-native-reference-workflow`.

The test decodes these exact bytes and uses actual MediaPipe face landmarks,
semantic projection, and the unchanged inferred nose target. It binds an
explicitly reviewed point on Actorwright's product-owned head mesh, uses a
synthetic nonzero native TRI resource, and follows production services through
accepted JSlot writing, CLI NPC materialization, and preview. Four small role
markers are regression geometry; they are not anatomical likeness assets.

Review documents represent synthetic operator attestation. Actual native preview
validator results are retained separately from rendered pixels; neither grants
human likeness approval or game-runtime authority. The portrait depicts no real
or named person and is not the original Yuna source; that
issue supplied image hashes without image bytes.
